evidence.reason: The denylist scan forces raw text but leaves rename detection enabled. `git log -p` can render a pure rename as a rename header with no added lines, so an unchanged file can be moved from an exempt path to a non-exempt path without its content being scanned, and path-based checks are not applied to added content. Adding `--no-renames` is a compatible, routine correctness fix: the rename is then emitted as a delete plus add, restoring scan coverage.
